refactor.subject: Add @directus/cli (#27861)
refactor.message:
Add @directus/cli (#27861)

* Add @directus/cli scaffold and kernel

Client-side, plugin-based CLI package (private, unpublished). Bins directus-cli and d6s. Kernel: zod-driven arg parser over node:util parseArgs, plugin registry and dispatch, hand-rolled Result error boundary (SCREAMING_SNAKE codes matching @directus/errors), generated help, a chalk UI layer (unicode-aware symbols with ASCII fallback, --no-color, stdout/stderr plus --json separation), and lazy clack interactive prompts (interactive by default; guarded off in CI, non-TTY, and --json). 35 tests; tsdown build extending @directus/tsconfig/node22.

* Use lodash-es and drop trivial indirection in @directus/cli kernel

* Strip plugin registry and Result type from @directus/cli kernel

* Add secret redaction, error detail, and .env loading to CLI kernel

* Add config loading and profile resolution to @directus/cli

* Add credential resolution and SDK connection to @directus/cli

* Add profile commands to @directus/cli

add/list/test/remove over a committable directus.config.json. Config writers preserve unknown top-level namespaces; tokens resolve via the flag/env/store chain and never enter config or output.

* Tighten @directus/cli: drop dead surface, inline helpers

Remove unused ui.step() and CliErrorCode CONTRACT/SYNC. connection.ts: use lodash get, inline firstNonEmpty/statusOf, demote Identity. Drop redundant parseArgs array copy; fix the package description (was 'plugin-based').

* Fix credential-store data
